header.h1: LeadSmart fits into the workflow you already have.
header.summary: {{live}} live integrations and {{rest}} more in beta or coming soon — across lead sources, calendar, email, telephony, e-signature, billing, and AI.
header.ask_post: — we ship requested integrations on a 2-week cadence.

lead_sources.title: Lead sources
lead_sources.description: Pull new leads in from every channel — portals, social ads, your own website. Everything flows through AI follow-up automatically.

zillow.name: Zillow Premier Agent
zillow.description: Connect your Zillow account so new buyer / seller inquiries land in the Lead Queue within seconds and trigger AI follow-up.

realtor.name: Realtor.com
realtor.description: Sync new Realtor.com leads with the same routing rules as Zillow. Source attribution is preserved on every contact.

facebook.name: Facebook Lead Ads
facebook.description: Run Meta lead ads and feed responses straight into LeadSmart. Custom field mapping for buyer / seller / open-house forms.

idx.name: IDX website webhook
idx.description: One-line embed for any IDX site (Sierra, kvCORE, custom WordPress) — new form submissions hit LeadSmart in under a second.

google_lsa.name: Google Local Service Ads
google_lsa.description: Pipe Google LSA inquiries into the same AI follow-up sequences as your portal leads.

open_house_qr.name: Open-house QR signup
open_house_qr.description: Native open-house signup page — visitors scan a QR code and land in your CRM with auto-tagging and source attribution.

calendar_email.title: Calendar & email
calendar_email.description: Two-way sync with the calendar and inbox you already live in. Every appointment, sent message, and reply lands on the contact timeline.

google.name: Google Workspace
google.description: Two-way calendar sync, Gmail thread attachment, OAuth-based sending so your replies come from your real email address.

microsoft.name: Microsoft 365 / Outlook
microsoft.description: Calendar + email sync with the same OAuth pattern as Google. Your Outlook events appear on the LeadSmart calendar.

apple.name: Apple iCloud Calendar
apple.description: Read-only sync via CalDAV so you can see Apple-calendar events alongside LeadSmart bookings.

telephony.title: Voice & SMS
telephony.description: Twilio powers every call and text — dialer, missed-call text-back, AI voice answering, and the carrier-registered SMS pipeline.

twilio_voice.name: Twilio voice
twilio_voice.description: Click-to-call dialer + AI voice answering for inbound. Calls are recorded, transcribed, and summarized on the contact record.

twilio_sms.name: Twilio SMS (A2P 10DLC)
twilio_sms.description: Carrier-registered SMS pipeline with high daily throughput. Powers missed-call text-back, AI follow-up, and template sends.

whatsapp.name: WhatsApp Business
whatsapp.description: Same AI follow-up flow, routed through WhatsApp Business — useful for international clients and Chinese-American buyers.

wechat.name: WeChat Official Account
wechat.description: Native WeChat OA integration for agents serving Chinese-speaking clients. Bilingual templates ship with the platform.

voice_ai.title: Voice AI
voice_ai.description: The AI receptionist that answers calls, and the voice cloning that lets it sound like you.

retell.name: Retell AI
retell.description: Powers the AI receptionist — real-time conversation that answers, qualifies, books, and hands off, with recordings and summaries on the contact.

elevenlabs.name: ElevenLabs
elevenlabs.description: Clones your voice from a short intro video so your digital twin and voice-line call-backs sound like you.

media.title: AI video & media
media.description: Turn a listing or a script into polished video — cinematic clips, talking-avatar reels, and branded edits.

fal.name: fal.ai
fal.description: The generative-media backbone — runs the video, transcription, and lip-sync models below on fast, scalable infrastructure.

seedance.name: Seedance
seedance.description: Text-and-photo-to-video for UGC-style listing and brand ads.

wizper.name: Wizper
wizper.description: Fast, accurate transcription — turns your intro video into the script behind your digital twin.

lipsync.name: Sync Lipsync
lipsync.description: Lip-syncs your cloned voice onto your avatar so a talking-head reel matches every word.

remotion.name: Remotion
remotion.description: Programmatic, on-brand video — carousel and listing reels rendered from your data.

kling.name: Kling
kling.description: Cinematic image-to-video for high-end listing and lifestyle clips.

veo.name: Google Veo
veo.description: State-of-the-art text-to-video for premium marketing shots.

social.title: Social publishing
social.description: Connect your accounts once and your Marketing Assistant writes, schedules, and auto-posts across every channel.

meta.name: Facebook & Instagram
meta.description: One Meta connection publishes to your Facebook Page and linked Instagram Business account.

linkedin.name: LinkedIn
linkedin.description: Auto-post market updates, listings, and brand content to your LinkedIn profile or page.

threads.name: Threads
threads.description: Publish text and image posts to Threads on your posting schedule.

pinterest.name: Pinterest
pinterest.description: Pin listing photos and market graphics to boards that keep working for you.

tiktok.name: TikTok
tiktok.description: Publish short-form listing and brand video to TikTok.

youtube.name: YouTube
youtube.description: Upload listing tours and brand reels to your YouTube channel.

esignature.title: E-signature
esignature.description: Send Buyer Broker Agreements, offers, and listing agreements for signature without leaving the deal record.

dotloop.name: Dotloop
dotloop.description: Send the Buyer Broker Agreement, listing agreement, or offer for signature from any deal. Status flips on the deal record when the recipient signs.

docusign.name: DocuSign
docusign.description: Alternate e-signature provider with the same workflow as Dotloop. Pick once in Settings; templates port over.

billing.title: Billing
billing.description: Stripe powers checkout, subscription management, and proration. Update payment methods and download invoices self-serve.

stripe.name: Stripe
stripe.description: All plans, proration, payment-method swaps, and invoice history. ACH supported on Premium and Team plans.

ai.title: AI providers
ai.description: AI-generated replies, drafts, and analysis are powered by frontier models. The provider stack is transparent and swappable.

anthropic.name: Anthropic Claude
anthropic.description: Primary model for AI follow-up drafting, voice AI conversation, deal coach reasoning, and the AI CMA analyzer.

openai.name: OpenAI GPT
openai.description: Secondary model used as a fallback and for image-aware tasks (listing photo analysis, CMA imagery).

automation.title: Automation & developer access
automation.description: Connect LeadSmart to anything via webhooks or general-purpose automation platforms.

zapier.name: Zapier
zapier.description: Standard Zapier app — trigger on New lead, New conversation, Deal stage change, and act with Send template, Create task, Update contact.

make.name: Make.com
make.description: Make.com scenario support with the same triggers and actions as Zapier.

webhooks.name: Custom webhooks
webhooks.description: POST any event from LeadSmart to your own endpoint, or accept inbound webhooks to create leads / contacts / tasks from external systems.

cta.body: We ship one new integration every other week, prioritized by paying-customer demand. Tell us what you need and we'll tell you when it's landing.
